name: kingston-tutoring
description: Independent peer tutoring booking pilot: public booking Worker + tutor dashboard Worker on Cloudflare with D1 and Stripe Checkout.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build:test && vitest run
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build:test && vitest run test/acceptance
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:test && BROWSER_CHECKS=1 vitest run
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state -c workers/public/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c workers/public/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy:public && npm run deploy:admin
